title: Crown Crafting Motif 46: Frostcaster Style
flavorText: Use to learn the Stalhrim Frostcaster crafting and outfit styles.
name: Crown Crafting Motif 46: Frostcaster Style

title: Disposable Swallower's Sword
flavorText: This false sword is made from spun sugar. It rapidly dissolves after a single use. Though intended for beginner sword-swallowers, no particular skill is needed beyond the ability to open one's mouth.
name: Disposable Swallower's Sword

title: Disposable Juggling Knives
flavorText: These false knives appear authentic, but are actually made from kwama cuttle that softens quickly when handled. Preferred by stage performers to delight and amaze with seemingly "perilous" knife tricks.
name: Disposable Juggling Knives

title: Fire-Breather's Oil Bun
flavorText: This small wad of steamed dough can be tucked between tooth and cheek. Performers bite down to release the reservoir of oil within, then spray it across a lit torch to spectacular effect.
name: Fire-Breather's Oil Bun

title: Mud Ball
flavorText: A single gooey mud ball, ready for tossing at an unsuspecting target.
name: Mud Ball
